name: uictl-linux-mcp
notes: The README calls the project incomplete and lists a .NET 10 SDK build on Ubuntu 26.04. It describes a companion GNOME Shell extension for Wayland window management and /dev/uinput setup for input synthesis.
summary: uictl-linux-mcp is a developing Linux/GNOME CLI and MCP server for agent control of GUI applications through screenshots, accessibility data, and input actions.
